'''Air brakes''' were components that helped to slow down [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]]<ref name="SG" /> and [[Podracer/Legends|podracers]]. Better air brakes were used to decrease the amount of time to slow a podracer down, although the brakes were best used to slow the vehicle down for taking sharp turns, as opposed to coming to a complete stop. The [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] [[Merchant/Legends|parts dealer]] [[Watto/Legends|Watto]] sold air brakes for [[Trugut/Legends|truguts]].
